residuals.detail: The source self-hosts Gotham (GothamBold / GothamMedium / Gotham-Light via themes/balbriggan2024/fonts/font.css) — a licensed commercial kit, never rehosted. Stacks keep the Gotham names first; Montserrat 400/500/700 (OFL) substitutes, chosen by measured glyph widths (ratios 0.99 / 0.98 / 1.01). Effects: nav labels ±2–8px x, ±2–4px width; inline anchor height 15→19px (footer Privacy); carousel titles wrap into fewer lines in the 90px-wide mobile cards (news-title 216→168px at 360); 2px total height delta at both widths. A licensed Gotham drop-in (owner action) removes all of these without a code change.

residuals.class: intentional deviation for the hard assert
residuals.detail: The source overflows the 360 viewport by 10px (slick-next at right:-25px). The build clips it (.section-whatsnew overflow-x: clip) so the build stays within the 4px tolerance; the clipped strip held only a white arrow glyph over the light band.
Hero is an autoplaying muted Vimeo mp4 under a #009bd9 multiply overlay on both sides (embed passthrough per dynamic-features.md); frame timing differs per capture, band 0–1000 measured 0.5–1.6%.
The inline map SVG references 12 relative PNGs (02_Our Balbriggan_MapN.png) that 404 on the source; replicated as captured (they 404 on the build too).

chrome-parity exits 2 on 11 text-metric deltas at 1440 (header Δx ≤ 8px, Δw ≤ 4px; footer "Privacy" Δh +4px) and 1 at 360 — glyph metrics of the Montserrat substitute for the licensed Gotham kit; identical set from iter3 through conf3. Supplying the licensed kit removes it.
.map-pin:hover scale(1.1) + label translate lifted from style.css; the hover probe measures no transform change on live or build — same result both sides.
